species: Here, we have profiled total membrane proteomes of the C. glabrata wildtype and 11 proteases-deficient strain, Cgyps1-11Δ, by mass spectrometry analysis and uncovered a novel role for fungal yapsins in glucose sensing and homeostasis.
sample_source: For this, we performed global proteome analyses on total membrane fractions (TMFs) of log-phase grown cells of wt and Cgyps1-11Δ strains in duplicates.
